sloka: स सौष्ठवोपेतमदीनवादिनः कपेर्निशम्याप्रतिमो ऽप्रियं वचः ।दशाननः कोपविवृत्तलोचनः समादिशत् तस्य वधं महाकपेः ।। ५.५१.४६।।
transliteration: sa sauṣṭhavopetamadīnavādinaḥ kaperniśamyāpratimo 'priyaṁ vacaḥ ।daśānanaḥ kopavivṛttalocanaḥ samādiśat tasya vadhaṁ mahākapeḥ ।। 5.51.46।।

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana who was of matchless strength, hearing the unpleasant words of advice and warning expressed skilfully with dignity by the great Hanuman, enraged Ravana, his eyes rolling in anger ordered the execution of Hanuman. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
